name: basic-async-operations-test-5353eae739/basic-async-operations-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.error lists only "message" and ballerina/lang.future is absent.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" (list includes error:message, but no future:cancel or error:detail).
Expressions: "Start action" and "Wait action" are supported.
reason: Although start/wait and runtime:sleep are supported, the executed test requires future cancellation via f2.cancel(), f3.cancel(), f4.cancel() and f1.cancel(). The supported langlib lists omit ballerina/lang.future and future:cancel. testAsyncNonNativeBasic9 also checks cancellation error details with result.detail(), whereas lang.error supports only message. These essential calls make the whole case a feature request.
test_design_notes: main asserts numeric and boolean outputs and executes cancellation behavior; testAsyncNonNativeBasic9 accepts either the cancellation error with a particular message and empty details or the alternate future result 7.
No @args or @panic directives occur; io:println serves as output instrumentation.
